attchmntText: ABM International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: ABM International Limited filed its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and year-to-date ended 30th September, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November, 2026. Statutory auditors Salarpuria & Partners reviewed the statement under Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company reported a loss after tax of Rs. 40.69 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, compared to a profit of Rs. 68.30 lakhs in the corresponding previous quarter. For the year-to-date period from 1st April, 2026, to 30th September, 2026, the company reported a profit after tax of Rs. 137.76 lakhs, compared to a loss of Rs. 49.49 lakhs in the previous year. Basic earnings per share were negative Rs. 0.43 for the quarter and positive Rs. 1.46 for the year-to-date period.
